intro.headline: InSync Operational Assessment
intro.subheadline: Are you getting everything you can out of your Qualifacts partnership?
intro.body: Most InSync customers are only using a fraction of what their Qualifacts partnership offers. This 4-minute check covers five areas (clinical documentation, grants tracking, revenue cycle management, measurement-based care, and appointment reminders) to pinpoint your hidden opportunities and the add-ons that close them.

questions.text: After a session, when do providers finish their notes?

options.label: They chart during sessions and it pulls focus off the client

questions.text: Roughly how much of a provider's day goes to documentation vs client time?
Are providers finishing notes after hours or on personal time?
Does your organization manage grant or contract funding?
If your organization uses grant or contract funding, how do you currently track related services, requirements, and reporting today?

options.label: Mostly manual tracking through spreadsheets or shared documents
Through our EHR or practice management system
Through a separate grant management tool
Through reports pulled from multiple systems
We do not currently track this in a structured way

questions.text: Have you ever had to write off or manually reconcile grant-funded services to force a balance to zero?
Could you produce audit-ready grant utilization reporting on short notice?
Do any funders require you to survey clients at set intervals and report results back?

options.label: Yes and it's a manual scramble

questions.text: How confident are you that you're collecting everything you're owed?

options.label: We leave some on the table

questions.text: What happens to billing continuity when a key biller is out or leaves?
How are you handling denials and appeals today?

options.label: We don't have capacity to work them all

questions.text: Credentialing: are enrollments and revalidations tracked so you can bill on time?
Do your payers, funders, or accreditors require outcomes, MBC, VBC, or MIPS reporting today, or expect to soon?
How do you collect and report client outcomes now?
Measurement-based care is increasingly becoming an accreditation and payer requirement. Where do you stand?
Can you demonstrate program efficacy to funders and payers with objective data?
What does your no-show situation look like?
How many appointment reminders does your organization typically send before each scheduled appointment?
Does one reminder feel like enough, or do patients still forget after it?

options.label: We're back on the phone following up manually

questions.text: Are you currently using multiple appointment reminders for each scheduled appointment?

options.label: No, we only send one reminder
No, we do not currently send appointment reminders

questions.text: If you could have anything developed for your EHR, what would you like to see?
questions.placeholder: Please don't include any client information.

tiers.label: Fully Leveraged
tiers.summary: You're getting strong value from your Qualifacts partnership across these areas.
tiers.body: You're getting strong value out of your Qualifacts partnership across most of these areas. A few refinements could close the remaining gaps — worth a quick conversation with your account team about the add-ons that would round things out.

tiers.label: Solid, With Gaps
tiers.summary: You're using InSync well in places, but there are meaningful gaps worth closing.
tiers.body: You're using InSync well in places, but there are meaningful gaps that may be costing you time, revenue, or compliance coverage. Several of these are exactly what the add-ons already available in your Qualifacts partnership are built to solve.

tiers.label: Meaningful Opportunity
tiers.summary: Multiple modules show real gaps that are likely costing you time and revenue.
tiers.body: Multiple modules show real gaps. Most organizations in this range are leaving measurable time, revenue, or compliance coverage on the table — and much of it is solvable with add-ons already part of your Qualifacts partnership.

tiers.label: Significant Opportunity
tiers.summary: Your organization is carrying a lot of manual work and risk your partnership can likely already solve.
tiers.body: Your organization is carrying a lot of manual work and risk that your Qualifacts partnership can likely already solve. This is worth an urgent conversation with your account team about the InSync add-ons you're not yet using.
